snippet.title: Dark Queen of Samobor - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Embark on a journey inspired by Slavic mythology and Croatian folklore in this 2.5D action-adventure game inspired by the likes of Inside, Song of Iron, and Planet of Lana.

🔼 Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3106050/Dark_Queen/
🎮 Join our Discord community: https://discord.gg/3resJ8umfu
